MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive-lined heat shrink felt like a useful next step after my crimp terminals because it would seal and protect those wiring connections.",
    "The epoxy fit my history of buying tape and vinyl cement because it offers another way to make durable repairs, especially on rigid materials."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs and threaded valve require specific wire sizes or fittings that my earlier connector and hose-clamp purchases do not establish I need.",
    "The feeler gauge, thermometer, grinding discs, cutting wheels, and lubricant would each need a particular repair task to justify buying them; I do not currently have those tasks.",
    "Both heat shrink kits were relevant, but I would choose the adhesive-lined kit now because sealing connections matters more to me than getting a second assortment."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of repair supplies seemed to be taken as interest in almost any workshop tool or consumable.",
    "Having bought electrical connectors or hose clamps seemed to count too strongly toward specialized electrical and plumbing parts, despite their different requirements."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A useful match should either work with supplies I already bought or solve a closely related repair need, with attention to sizes and connections.",
    "I buy selectively for a purpose: general usefulness alone does not mean I need something now, and two alternatives for the same job do not mean I would buy both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but often stretched them into specialized tasks and equipment needs I have not shown."
}
